title: Uruguayan Beef Stew
description: A hearty, keto-friendly stew from Uruguay featuring tender beef and a rich broth.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the Uruguayan seasoning to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cabbage and cook until slightly softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the nourishing broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 1 1/2 hours or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
